assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias.
The diagnosis I48.91 is associated with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period.
The CPT code 93229 corresponds to the mobile cardiac telemetry service.
The recurrent syncope is coded as R55.
The palpitations are documented in the clinical indication note.
The diagnosis codes I49.9, I48.91, and R55 support the medical necessity of the monitoring service.
The indication note describes the medical necessity of the monitoring service.
